key_insight: Bitcoin market sentiment can be classified by combining on-chain blockchain activity, historical price data, and daily Twitter sentiment, with XGBoost giving the strongest results.
engineering_relevance: The study shows how multi-source financial and blockchain data can be fused into an interpretable machine-learning pipeline for sentiment-aware crypto analytics.
method: Merged on-chain metrics, Bitcoin price history, and Twitter sentiment into a normalized dataset.
Trained and compared multiple machine-learning classifiers with cross-validation.
Used SHAP to explain which on-chain features most influenced sentiment predictions.
evidence_signal: Across cross-validation experiments, Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) achieved the best performance with an average F1-score of about 0.84.
watch_item: Results depend on the quality and alignment of social-media sentiment and blockchain/price timestamps, so data leakage or label noise could affect robustness.
paper_title: Decoding Market Emotion from Blockchain Activity: A Data-Driven Sentiment Classifier
